descriptor.scene: AN INFUSION SUITE MADE HUMAN. DAVID KOBROSKY sits in a recliner chair by a big window, chest-up and large in frame, a soft KNIT BEANIE where his curls would be, an IV line taped to his forearm and a slim laptop open ON HIS LAP with ITS SCREEN FACING HIM, his hands on the keys. He is thinner in the face and unmistakably HIMSELF: the grin is intact, aimed down at the work, undefeated. A warm blanket, a smoothie cup on the side table, afternoon light across the floor. The picture's argument is a spirit that did not take the season off. Lower-right: sunlit linoleum, calm.
descriptor._caption: In the middle of the building years, his own body picked a fight. Stage four blood cancer, the kind that comes with twelve rounds of chemo. David did the rounds, kept a full head of plans if not of hair, and kept building all the way through.
negatives: gaunt hopelessness: the mood is quiet defiance
